data.name: HeroMiniBadgeText
data.value: Digital management platform for scientific events

data.name: HeroModernDescription
data.value: Easily manage abstract submission, peer review, registration, payment, program creation, and certificate processes with AntAbstract.

data.name: ForWhoTitle
data.value: A simple and powerful experience for every role

data.name: ForWhoDescription
data.value: Author, reviewer, and organizing team processes are managed in the same system with panels tailored to different needs.

data.name: AuthorRoleDescription
data.value: Register for a conference, submit abstracts, track their status, and easily access acceptance/rejection letters.

data.name: ReviewerRoleDescription
data.value: Review assigned submissions, complete the evaluation form, and finish the peer review process.

data.name: OrganizerRoleDescription
data.value: Manage conference website, registrations, payments, reviewer assignments, program, and certificate processes.

data.name: CongressCalendarDescription
data.value: Browse active organizations with open applications that you can attend.

data.name: CongressDefaultDescription
data.value: You can review conference details and proceed with registration and abstract submission.

data.name: NoActiveCongressDescription
data.value: New conferences will appear here when added.

data.name: HowItWorksTitle
data.value: The conference process progresses smoothly from start to finish

data.name: HowItWorksDescription
data.value: From participant registration to peer review, from program to certificate — the entire flow is tracked from a single platform.

data.name: Workflow1Text
data.value: The user browses active conferences and visits the relevant event page.

data.name: Workflow2Text
data.value: The participant selects a registration type, enters their information, and starts the process.

data.name: Workflow3Text
data.value: The author uploads their abstract and adds topic and author information to the system.

data.name: Workflow4Text
data.value: Reviewers evaluate submissions; results and certificates are tracked through the system.

data.name: FeaturesDescription
data.value: AntAbstract is not just a registration system; it is a comprehensive management platform that digitizes conference management.

data.name: FeatureSubmissionDescription
data.value: Abstract submission, author information, file upload, and revision processes are managed in an organized way.

data.name: FeatureReviewerDescription
data.value: Reviewer assignments, evaluation forms, and decision processes are tracked through the panel.

data.name: FeaturePaymentDescription
data.value: Participant registrations and payment statuses can be easily monitored from the management panel.

data.name: FeatureWebsiteDescription
data.value: A custom page, content blocks, images, and multilingual structure are supported for each conference.

data.name: FeatureProgramDescription
data.value: Sessions, presentations, and conference programs can be created in an organized manner.

data.name: FeatureCertificateDescription
data.value: Author and reviewer certificates are generated by the system when appropriate conditions are met.

data.name: CtaTitle
data.value: Ready to make conference management more organized?

data.name: CtaDescription
data.value: Manage registration, submissions, peer review, program, and certificate processes from a single panel with AntAbstract.
